coordinates: glTF +Y up; glTF (x, y, z) = (game x, game y, game z); Blender (X, Y, Z) = (x, -z, y)
normal_maps: OpenGL convention (+Y green up), tangent space

oak.note: atlas: u = plank column, v = 0..5.4 m along the plank; not a 2D tile

vertex_data.COLOR_0: masks: R wetness/slime, G lime/halo/runnel/efflorescence, B soot/grime, A moss (0..1)
vertex_data._AO: baked ambient occlusion, 0.6 m distance, 1 = open
vertex_data._BAKECOL: baked render base colour of the masonry (linear RGB), for reference or as a tint
vertex_data.UVMap: tiling UVs: 1 unit = one texture tile of the family set

images: not embedded: material ruien_<family> uses export/textures/ruien_<family>_*.png (see textures below)

daylight_openings.name: vleeshuis_hatch
daylight_openings.note: stairwell open to the hall at z_open; the hatch leaves stand open

mist.name: rot_mist_gallery
mist.note: low mist hugging the water, thickest near the surface

mist.name: rot_mist_hall
mist.note: low mist hugging the water, thickest near the surface

mist.name: rot_mist_vliet
mist.note: low mist hugging the water, thickest near the surface

outlet.note: x = game x, y = game height; the opening is the hole, the dressing outline is where the bluestone frame ends

outlet_door_n.axis: glTF +Y (vertical hinge line through the pivot)
outlet_door_n.note: open pose = rotate about +Y by open_rotation_y_deg (right-handed, glTF); opens toward -z, the river side; the river pushes it shut, it opens when the river falls below the water inside (-4.6)

outlet_door_s.axis: glTF +Y (vertical hinge line through the pivot)
outlet_door_s.note: open pose = rotate about +Y by open_rotation_y_deg (right-handed, glTF); opens toward -z, the river side; the river pushes it shut, it opens when the river falls below the water inside (-4.6)

gallery_penstock_door.rest: as exported: door foot at y -4.85 (raised 1.25 m above the bed)
gallery_penstock_door.travel_note: translate along glTF +Y: min = shut on the bed (-6.10), max = door foot at the ledges (-3.60)

lod_policy.lod0: relief baked at 2 to 3 cm spacing near the player, then edge-collapse decimated to 55 percent (silhouettes kept; sub-centimetre relief left to the normal and height maps); props 70 percent
lod_policy.lod1: one subdivision level less, then the same decimation; props 30 percent

outlet_scope: outlet_gate holds the outlet only: arch dressing, jambs, sill, apron, pintles, weed and slime on the head wall face, rubbish on the apron; the door leaves are separate (outlet_door_n, outlet_door_s). The town keeps its own vliet: our quay walls, bed, quay coping and vliet debris are not exported. Our brick head wall round the arch is optional in ruien_o2_outlet_headwall_*.glb.
